doc.what: Innervation group families for the "Related structures" menu: root (myotome), peripheral nerve, central pattern.
doc.schema: muscles{id: {muscle_id, name, region, repo_record, structures {base_m|base_f: {r,l,mid}}, nerves[], roots_text, motor_levels[], cranial_nerves[], non_motor_levels, segmental, roots_range_across_sources, roots_conflict, sources[], source_of_roots, on_base_pages, isncsci_key_muscle_for}}. families.root.levels{C5: {members[], isncsci_key_muscles}}; families.root.cranial{CN VII: [...]}. families.peripheral.nerves{id: {name, parent, level, plexus, roots, cranial, direct_members[], all_members[] {muscle_id, via, role}}}. families.central.patterns[] {id, name, limb, kind synergy|hefter_asp|regional, status, components[] {label, moves [[joint, dof, sign]], source, opened}, members[] {muscle_id, part, tier, components[], action_quotes[], structures}}.
doc.ui: Innervation -> sub-menu root | peripheral | central. Root: offer the clicked muscle's motor_levels; selecting a level marks all members (flag ISNCSCI key muscles). Peripheral: offer the clicked muscle's nerves and their parent chain; selecting marks all_members. Central: offer patterns whose members include the clicked muscle (status ok only); show the rule-based badge and the tier legend. Side: mark the clicked side only by default (central patterns are one-sided), with a "both sides" toggle for root and peripheral.
doc.public_content: Anatomy and neurology only: no treatment technique, amounts or approach is recorded here.

central.label: Central pattern (upper-motor-neuron posture)
central.rule: Each pattern is a set of joint positions taken from an opened source. Members are DERIVED BY RULE (badge: rule-based): a muscle is a member when one of its sourced actions in data/anatomy/muscle_actions_q283.json (actions quoted from data/muscles records or cited papers) produces one of the pattern's joint positions. tier: named_in_guide (the source names the muscle for this pattern) > guide_section_and_action (listed in the guide's section for that region and the action matches) > action_only (action matches; not listed by the guide) > guide_section_only (listed in the guide's region section and the repo action table has no action for it at all). Default view: the first two tiers.
central.excluded: Decorticate and decerebrate postures: no muscle-level source was opened -> not offered. "Striatal toe" is not used: the opened guide names "hyperextension of the great toe" / "Hitchhiker's great toe".
